papers.title: Skeletal muscle enhancer programming of intrinsic cardiorespiratory fitness
papers.translated_title: 骨骼肌增强子编程决定内在心肺适能
papers.author: Weitzel, A. M.
papers.summary: Cardiorespiratory fitness (CRF) is a heritable trait associated with improved metabolic health and longevity. Integrating 546 transcriptomic and epigenomic profiles from skeletal muscle of 128 genetically heterogeneous rats selectively bred for high and low running capacity (HCR and LCR), a model that mirrors CRF-associated traits in humans, we identify a distributed enhancer architecture underlying their divergent transcriptomes. Line-divergent alleles were concentrated in distal enhancers: those more active in HCR were enriched for ETS-family transcription factor motifs and positively linked to hundreds of mitochondrial oxidative metabolism and angiogenesis genes, whereas those more active in LCR were enriched for Mef2 motifs and negatively linked to these genes. In 426 genotype, gene expression, and chromatin accessibility profiles from an independent HCRxLCR F2 population (n=147), we validated thousands of these genetic effects. Thus, heritable CRF reflects many enhancers cumulatively tuning energy metabolism and oxygen delivery, providing a molecular basis for variation in CRF.
papers.translated_summary: 心肺适能（CRF）是一种可遗传的性状，与改善代谢健康和延长寿命相关。我们整合了128只遗传异质性大鼠骨骼肌的546个转录组和表观基因组图谱，这些大鼠经过选择性繁育以获得高和低奔跑能力（HCR和LCR），该模型反映了人类中与CRF相关的性状，从而识别出支撑其差异转录组的分布式增强子架构。品系差异等位基因集中于远端增强子：在HCR中更活跃的增强子富集ETS家族转录因子基序，并与数百个线粒体氧化代谢和血管生成基因正相关；而在LCR中更活跃的增强子富集Mef2基序，并与这些基因负相关。在一个独立的HCRxLCR F2群体（n=147）的426个基因型、基因表达和染色质可及性图谱中，我们验证了数千个此类遗传效应。因此，可遗传的CRF反映了众多增强子累积性地调控能量代谢和氧气输送，为CRF的变异提供了分子基础。

papers.title: Design of Orthogonal Far-Red, Orange and Green Fluorophore-binding Proteins for Multiplex Imaging
papers.translated_title: 用于多重成像的正交远红、橙色和绿色荧光团结合蛋白的设计
papers.author: Tran, L.
papers.summary: Fluorescent proteins have transformed biological imaging, yet their limited photostability and brightness restrict their applications. We used deep learning-based de novo protein design methods to design binders to three bright, stable and cell-permeable dyes spanning the imaging spectrum: JF657 (far red), JF596 (orange-red) and JF494 (green). We obtain highly specific dye-binding proteins with low nanomolar affinities for the intended target; a crystal structure of one binder confirms close resemblance to the design model. Simultaneous labeling of mammalian cells expressing three dye-specific binders at different subcellular compartments demonstrates the utility in multiplex imaging. We further expand the functionality of the binder by incorporating an active site that carries out nucleophilic aromatic substitution to form a covalent linkage with the dye, and develop split versions which reconstitute fluorescence at subcellular locations where both halves are present towards monitoring in-cell protein interactions and chemically induced dimerization. Our designed high affinity and specificity dye binders open up new opportunities for multiplexed biological imaging.
papers.translated_summary: 荧光蛋白已经改变了生物成像，但其有限的光稳定性和亮度限制了其应用。我们使用基于深度学习的从头蛋白质设计方法来设计针对三种明亮、稳定且可透过细胞的染料的结合蛋白，这三种染料覆盖了成像光谱：JF657（远红）、JF596（橙红）和JF494（绿色）。我们获得了对目标具有低纳摩尔亲和力的高度特异性染料结合蛋白；其中一个结合蛋白的晶体结构证实其与设计模型高度相似。在不同亚细胞区室中表达三种染料特异性结合蛋白的哺乳动物细胞的同时标记，展示了多重成像中的实用性。我们通过引入一个活性位点进一步扩展了结合蛋白的功能，该位点进行亲核芳香取代以与染料形成共价连接，并开发了分裂版本，在两部分均存在的亚细胞位置重建荧光，用于监测细胞内蛋白质相互作用和化学诱导二聚化。我们设计的高亲和力和高特异性染料结合蛋白为多重生物成像开辟了新机会。

papers.title: Dysfunctional effector programming in Foxp3-ΔE2 Tregs promotes enhanced CD8+ T cell responses
papers.translated_title: Foxp3-ΔE2 Tregs中效应功能的编程障碍促进CD8+ T细胞应答增强
papers.author: Weinstein, K. N.
papers.summary: Regulatory T cells (Tregs) prevent autoimmunity through suppressive functions largely programmed by the transcription factor FOXP3. Humans express two major alternatively spliced isoforms of FOXP3: a full-length version containing all coding exons (FOXP3-FL) and a version lacking Exon 2 (FOXP3-{Delta}E2). Sole FOXP3-{Delta}E2 expression causes lethal IPEX syndrome, indicating that FOXP3 Exon 2 is essential for full Treg function. Here, we used Foxp3-{Delta}E2 mice to determine how Foxp3 Exon 2 impacts the functional differentiation of Tregs at homeostasis and during inflammation. Analysis of central and effector Foxp3-{Delta}E2 Treg populations revealed dysfunctional effector Treg programming, including reduced expression of IL-2 receptor subunits, CTLA-4, and tissue-homing chemokine receptors. During influenza infection, reduced IL-2 regulation by Foxp3-{Delta}E2 Tregs and decreased Foxp3-{Delta}E2 Treg localization to the T cell zone during priming contributed to enhanced acute and memory CD8+ T cell responses. Thus, dysfunctional effector Treg programming by the Foxp3-{Delta}E2 isoform impairs suppressive function, resulting in failure to restrain CD8+ T cells and aberrant immune responses.
papers.translated_summary: 调节性T细胞（Tregs）通过主要由转录因子FOXP3编程的抑制功能防止自身免疫。人类表达两种主要的FOXP3选择性剪接异构体：包含所有编码外显子的全长版本（FOXP3-FL）和缺失外显子2的版本（FOXP3-{Delta}E2）。仅表达FOXP3-{Delta}E2会导致致死性IPEX综合征，表明FOXP3外显子2对完整的Treg功能至关重要。在此，我们使用Foxp3-{Delta}E2小鼠来确定Foxp3外显子2如何在稳态和炎症期间影响Treg的功能分化。对中枢和效应Foxp3-{Delta}E2 Treg群体的分析揭示了效应Treg编程功能障碍，包括IL-2受体亚基、CTLA-4和组织归巢趋化因子受体表达减少。在流感感染期间，Foxp3-{Delta}E2 Treg对IL-2的调节减少以及启动期间Foxp3-{Delta}E2 Treg向T细胞区定位减少，促成了增强的急性和记忆CD8+ T细胞应答。因此，Foxp3-{Delta}E2异构体导致的效应Treg编程功能障碍损害了抑制功能，导致无法约束CD8+ T细胞和异常免疫应答。

papers.title: Combined High Fat and Viral Insults in Pregnancy Disrupt Specific Placental Nutrient Transporter Systems in Mice
papers.translated_title: 孕期高脂与病毒感染双重打击破坏小鼠胎盘特定营养转运系统
papers.author: Ferraz, T.
papers.summary: The placenta adapts to support nutrient transport to meet the demands of the growing fetus. Maternal obesity and viral infection are associated with adverse fetoplacental development. How co-exposure affects placental morphology and nutrient transport across gestation remains unclear. We hypothesise that co-exposure would have a greater impact on placental morphology and nutrient transporter expression than either of the exposures alone. C57BL/6J mice were fed a control (CON) or high-fat (HF) diet before and throughout pregnancy and exposed to poly(I:C) or vehicle at gestational days (GD) 12.5, 15.5, or 18.5. Placental morphology, folate and fatty acid transporter mRNA expression and localisation were evaluated by haematoxylin and eosin staining, immunohistochemistry (reported as % immunoreactivity (ir)-area stained), and qPCR, respectively. At GD12.5, HF diet associated with reduced junctional zone (JZ) area and increased maternal blood space, followed by reduced fetal blood space at GD15.5 and increased JZ and labyrinth zone (LZ) area size by GD18.5. HF diet and viral infection independently associated with increased placental Fat/Cd36 mRNA expression at GD12.5. However, HF diet and infection associated with increased ir-FR- while HF diet alone decreased ir-PCFT at GD12.5. By GD15.5, HF diet associated with reduced placental ir-FR- but increased ir-PCFT. At GD18.5, infection associated with reduced Rfc1 mRNA expression. HF diet and infection associated with greater prevalence of SGA and LGA fetuses, particularly at GD18.5. Obesity and infection independently and jointly disrupted placental morphology and nutrient transporter expression in a zone- and gestational age-specific manner, with consequences for fetal growth across gestation.
papers.translated_summary: 胎盘会适应以支持营养转运，从而满足生长中胎儿的需要。母体肥胖和病毒感染与不良的胎儿-胎盘发育相关。共同暴露如何影响整个妊娠期的胎盘形态和营养转运仍不清楚。我们假设，共同暴露对胎盘形态和营养转运体表达的影响会大于任一单独暴露。C57BL/6J小鼠在妊娠前及整个妊娠期间被喂以对照（CON）或高脂（HF）饮食，并在妊娠日（GD）12.5、15.5或18.5暴露于poly(I:C)或溶媒。分别通过苏木精和伊红染色、免疫组织化学（报告为免疫反应性（ir）染色面积百分比）和qPCR评估胎盘形态、叶酸和脂肪酸转运体mRNA表达及定位。在GD12.5，HF饮食与交界区（JZ）面积减少和母体血窦增加相关，随后在GD15.5出现胎儿血窦减少，到GD18.5时JZ和迷路区（LZ）面积增大。HF饮食和病毒感染在GD12.5分别与胎盘Fat/Cd36 mRNA表达增加相关。然而，HF饮食和感染与ir-FR-增加相关，而单独HF饮食在GD12.5降低ir-PCFT。到GD15.5，HF饮食与胎盘ir-FR-减少但ir-PCFT增加相关。在GD18.5，感染与Rfc1 mRNA表达减少相关。HF饮食和感染与SGA和LGA胎儿的患病率更高相关，尤其是在GD18.5。肥胖和感染以区域和妊娠年龄特异性的方式独立并共同扰乱胎盘形态和营养转运体表达，并对整个妊娠期的胎儿生长产生影响。

papers.title: Structural features and conservation of the lncRNA HOTAIR in primates
papers.translated_title: 灵长类动物中lncRNA HOTAIR的结构特征与保守性
papers.author: Perry, Z. R.
papers.summary: Long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs) regulate diverse cellular processes and are frequently implicated in disease, but their functional mechanisms often remain elusive. One such lncRNA, HOTAIR (Hox transcript antisense intergenic RNA), is a ~2.1 kb mammalian transcript whose overexpression promotes invasion and metastasis in breast cancer. However, the mechanisms by which HOTAIR influences gene regulation in cancer are poorly understood. To approach this problem through a structural lens, we predicted the full-length in cellulo secondary structure of HOTAIR using chemical probing in a metastatic breast cancer cell line. The resulting structure shows that HOTAIR adopts a multidomain architecture and has local structural features unique to the cellular context. Comparison between in vitro and in cellulo chemical probing identifies regions of differential accessibility that may indicate context-dependent molecular interactions or folding. Conservation analyses further reveal that HOTAIR is conserved across primates with evidence of structural covariation in specific domains. Together, these results provide a roadmap for future mechanistic studies of structure-function relationships in HOTAIR and its contribution to gene regulation in cancer.
papers.translated_summary: 长链非编码RNA（lncRNA）调控多种细胞过程，并常与疾病相关，但其功能机制往往仍不明确。其中一个这样的lncRNA，HOTAIR（Hox转录本反义基因间RNA），是一种约2.1 kb的哺乳动物转录本，其过表达促进乳腺癌的侵袭和转移。然而，HOTAIR影响癌症基因调控的机制尚知之甚少。为了从结构角度探讨这一问题，我们利用化学探测在转移性乳腺癌细胞系中预测了HOTAIR的全长细胞内二级结构。所得结构显示HOTAIR采用多结构域架构，并具有细胞环境所特有的局部结构特征。体外与细胞内化学探测的比较识别出差异可及性区域，这可能指示环境依赖的分子相互作用或折叠。保守性分析进一步揭示HOTAIR在灵长类动物中保守，并具有特定结构域中结构共变异的证据。总之，这些结果为未来研究HOTAIR中结构-功能关系及其在癌症基因调控中贡献的机制提供了路线图。

papers.title: Synthetic genetic circuits that count developmental cues in plant roots
papers.translated_title: 在植物根部计数发育信号的合成基因回路
papers.author: Choi, S.
papers.summary: Plants explore soil environments through their roots, which branch repeatedly to access water and soil-borne nutrients. In many plants, root branches are generated by repeated developmental programs and molecular analyses have not identified markers that distinguish primary from later root branches. Consequently, efforts to engineer plant roots for improved water or nutrient acquisition are limited to changes that affect the entire root system. Here, we developed synthetic genetic circuits to count repeating root development cues and enable differential gene expression in successive root branches of the model plant Arabidopsis thaliana. The circuits use a root primordium-specific promoter to express large serine recombinases, which irreversibly invert segments of DNA each time a new lateral root is initiated. This converts repeating rounds of root formation into distinct, heritable DNA states. Because root branch specification and outgrowth occur over a ~2 day period, we tested circuit designs for their ability to count long-duration input pulses and developed an architecture that produces distinct fluorescence outputs in primary, secondary, and tertiary roots. By linking repeated developmental cues to distinct genetic outputs, synthetic genetic circuits that count enable root system engineering at the resolution of individual branches and offer a general strategy for dissecting developmental processes that rely on repeated signals.
papers.translated_summary: 植物通过根系探索土壤环境，根系反复分枝以获取水分和土壤中的养分。在许多植物中，根分枝由重复的发育程序产生，而分子分析尚未鉴定出能够区分初生根分枝与后续根分枝的标志物。因此，为改善水分或养分获取而改造植物根系的努力仅限于影响整个根系的变化。在此，我们开发了合成基因电路，用于计数重复的根系发育信号，并在模式植物拟南芥的连续根分枝中实现差异基因表达。这些电路利用根原基特异性启动子表达大型丝氨酸重组酶，每当新侧根起始时，这些酶不可逆地翻转DNA片段。这将重复的根系形成轮次转化为不同的、可遗传的DNA状态。由于根分枝特化和生长发生在约2天的时间内，我们测试了电路设计对长持续时间输入脉冲的计数能力，并开发了一种架构，在原根、二级根和三级根中产生不同的荧光输出。通过将重复的发育信号与不同的遗传输出相连接，计数型合成基因电路使根系工程能够在单个分枝的分辨率上进行，并为剖析依赖重复信号的发育过程提供了一种通用策略。

papers.title: Molecular sterics guide tmRNA translocation on the ribosome
papers.translated_title: 分子空间位阻引导核糖体上的tmRNA转运
papers.author: Wanes, G.
papers.summary: Translation of defective mRNA transcripts can lead to the formation of stalled ``non-stop'' ribosome complexes. To rescue these ribosomes, bacteria have evolved a mechanism called trans-translation that is mediated by transfer-messenger RNA (tmRNA) and small protein B (SmpB). During the translocation step of trans-translation, the stalled mRNA is ejected and the reading frame found in the mRNA-like domain (MLD) of tmRNA is loaded into the mRNA channel. The ribosome then translates the new template, thereby tagging the nascent protein for degradation. While structures of tmRNA-SmpB on the ribosome have been available for years, little is known about the molecular factors that govern the dynamics of tmRNA translocation. Here, we use an energetically smooth model (i.e. SMOG) to simulate translocation of tmRNA-SmpB, which reveals that the structure of the ribosome gives rise to a preferred sequence of conformational substeps. Specifically, the tRNA-like domain (TLD) translocates, then the MLD loads, and finally the C-terminal tail of SmpB rearranges. These steps are interdependent and associated with a range of sterically-induced barriers that regulate the kinetics. This provides a structural and energetic framework for understanding, and ultimately controlling, the dynamics of trans-translation.
papers.translated_summary: 缺陷mRNA转录本的翻译可能导致停滞的“非终止”核糖体复合物形成。为拯救这些核糖体，细菌演化出一种称为反式翻译的机制，该机制由转移信使RNA（tmRNA）和小蛋白B（SmpB）介导。在反式翻译的易位步骤中，停滞的mRNA被排出，tmRNA的类mRNA结构域（MLD）中的阅读框被加载到mRNA通道中。随后核糖体翻译这一新模板，从而将新生蛋白标记为降解对象。尽管tmRNA-SmpB在核糖体上的结构已有多年的研究，但人们对调控tmRNA易位动力学的分子因素知之甚少。在此，我们使用能量平滑模型（即SMOG）模拟tmRNA-SmpB的易位，揭示出核糖体的结构产生了一种优选的构象子步骤顺序。具体而言，类tRNA结构域（TLD）先易位，随后MLD加载，最后SmpB的C端尾部重排。这些步骤相互依赖，并伴随一系列空间位阻诱导的能垒，从而调控动力学。这为理解并最终控制反式翻译的动力学提供了结构与能量框架。

papers.title: Amide I kurtosis maps cardiac amyloid in human tissue by ultrabroadband multiplex coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering (CARS) microscopy
papers.translated_title: 酰胺I峰峰度通过超宽带多重相干反斯托克斯拉曼散射（CARS）显微镜在人体组织中对心脏淀粉样变性进行成像
papers.author: Ota, K.
papers.summary: Cardiac amyloidosis is caused by deposits of misfolded proteins in the heart and can lead to heart failure. Histological confirmation typically involves staining tissue sections with Congo red and examining them under polarized light for apple-green birefringence; however, achieving an interpretable, label-free, and observer-independent assessment remains challenging. Here we show that Pearson kurtosis of channel intensities within the amide I window provides an interpretable, fitting-free contrast for cardiac amyloid in unstained human cardiac tissue sections from ten participants imaged by ultrabroadband multiplex coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering (CARS). In a discovery participant, high-kurtosis regions corresponded with Congo red-positive tissue in two CARS-histology pairs of adjacent sections (descriptive spatial AUCs, 0.79 and 0.73). Across 15 fields from nine additional participants, field-level kurtosis values did not overlap between severe-deposition and Congo red-negative tissue fields. Among the descriptors examined, kurtosis showed the largest standardized participant-level separation. Exploratory multivariate curve resolution yielded a deposit-associated component with aromatic-residue features shared with reagent transthyretin. In one field from the discovery participant, the second harmonic generation (SHG) signal, acquired simultaneously with CARS, showed a broadly inverse spatial pattern relative to the amide I kurtosis map, revealing distinct tissue-architectural contrast. Together, these findings support a potential label-free approach to detecting cardiac amyloid deposits that combines amide I kurtosis derived from broadband CARS with SHG-derived architectural contrast.
papers.translated_summary: 心脏淀粉样变性由错误折叠蛋白在心脏中的沉积引起，可导致心力衰竭。组织学确认通常涉及用刚果红染色组织切片，并在偏振光下检查苹果绿双折射；然而，实现可解释、无标记且不依赖观察者的评估仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们表明，酰胺I窗口内通道强度的皮尔逊峰度可为来自十名参与者的未染色人类心脏组织切片中的心脏淀粉样变性提供可解释、无需拟合的对比，这些切片通过超宽带多重相干反斯托克斯拉曼散射（CARS）成像。在一名发现参与者中，高蜂度区域与两对相邻切片的CARS-组织学配对中刚果红阳性组织相对应（描述性空间AUC分别为0.79和0.73）。在来自另外九名参与者的15个视野中，严重沉积与刚果红阴性组织视野之间的视野级峰度值没有重叠。在所检查的描述符中，峰度显示出最大的标准化参与者级分离。探索性多元曲线分辨产生了一个与沉积相关的组分，其具有与试剂运甲状腺素蛋白共享的芳香残基特征。在发现参与者的一个视野中，与CARS同时获取的二次谐波产生（SHG）信号相对于酰胺I峰度图显示出广泛相反的空间模式，揭示了不同的组织结构对比。总之，这些发现支持一种潜在的无标记方法，用于检测心脏淀粉样变性沉积，该方法将源自宽带CARS的酰胺I峰度与源自SHG的结构对比相结合。

papers.title: Potassium modulates Phytophthora zoospore motility and flagellar beating through dose-dependent effects
papers.translated_title: 钾通过剂量依赖性效应调节疫霉游动孢子的运动性和鞭毛摆动。
papers.author: Lupatelli, C. A.
papers.summary: Biflagellate zoospores are critical agents in the spread of Phytophthora spp., plant pathogens causing major agronomic and economic losses worldwide. These motile cells navigate soil water films toward plant roots using taxis triggered by environmental cues. Here, we investigate how potassium modulates zoospore motility by analyzing trajectory and flagellar beating parameters across KCl concentrations. Using high-speed imaging, we apply kymograph analysis and Fourier transform of the cell body direction over time to quantify flagellar dynamics, while low-speed imaging provides trajectory characteristics. Our results demonstrate that increasing potassium concentration significantly reduces swimming speed while enhancing directional changes. We establish a direct correlation between altered swimming speed and changes in flagellar beating parameters. Our findings indicate that potassium differentially affects anterior and posterior flagella beating. Furthermore, potassium exerts multiple effects, influencing beat amplitude, wave propagation speed and direction- change frequency. This reveals potassium as a key modulator of zoospore motility, triggering a shift from exploratory swimming to confined, reoriented movement. By uncovering the biomechanical responses of zoospores to potassium, this study advances our understanding of how surrounding signals regulate pathogen dispersal in the environment.
papers.translated_summary: 双鞭毛游动孢子是疫霉属病原菌传播的关键因子，这类植物病原菌在全球范围内造成重大农业和经济损失。这些运动细胞利用环境信号触发的趋性，在土壤水膜中朝向植物根系游动。本研究通过分析不同KCl浓度下的运动轨迹和鞭毛摆动参数，探究钾离子如何调控游动孢子的运动性。我们采用高速成像技术，对细胞体方向随时间的变化进行运动轨迹图分析和傅里叶变换，以量化鞭毛动力学，同时利用低速成像获取轨迹特征。结果表明，钾离子浓度升高显著降低游动速度，同时增强方向改变。我们建立了游动速度变化与鞭毛摆动参数变化之间的直接相关性。研究发现，钾离子对前鞭毛和后鞭毛的摆动具有差异化影响。此外，钾离子发挥多重效应，影响摆动幅度、波传播速度和方向改变频率。这揭示钾离子是游动孢子运动性的关键调控因子，触发从探索性游动向受限、重新定向运动的转变。通过揭示游动孢子对钾离子的生物力学响应，本研究推进了我们对周围信号如何调控病原菌在环境中扩散的理解。

papers.title: STRUCTURAL AND MOLECULAR DYNAMICS ANALYSIS OF HUMAN β-DEFENSIN 1 VARIANTS REVEALS DISTINCT PERTURBATION SIGNATURES
papers.translated_title: 人类β-防御素1变体的结构与分子动力学分析揭示不同的扰动特征
papers.author: Fogarty, R. J.
papers.summary: Human {beta}-defensin 1 (hBD-1) is a small, disulfide-constrained antimicrobial peptide produced predominantly in the kidney and urogenital tract, where it contributes to epithelial innate defense. Genetic variation in the gene encoding hBD-1 has been associated with altered expression levels and susceptibility to infections, including infection following solid organ transplantation, yet the molecular consequences of coding substitutions in the active, mature form remain largely undefined. Here, we integrate conventional genomics, protein bioinformatics, structural modeling, and molecular dynamics to investigate the molecular consequences of 93 human-observed hBD-1 missense variants. Evaluation of hBD-1 missense variants across sequence-, structure-, and dynamics-based dimensions reveals variant-specific molecular perturbation signatures that complement conventional and static biophysical predictions. By treating naturally occurring substitutions as a perturbation series across a compact defensin scaffold, this study identifies multiple molecular routes through which sequence variation can remodel an endogenous antimicrobial peptide and prioritizes variants for direct structure-function testing. These findings provide a mechanistic framework for investigating how naturally occurring hBD-1 variation may influence peptide behavior and, ultimately, antimicrobial function.
papers.translated_summary: 人β防御素1（hBD-1）是一种小型、二硫键约束的抗菌肽，主要在肾脏和泌尿生殖道中产生，参与上皮先天防御。编码hBD-1的基因的遗传变异与表达水平改变及感染易感性相关，包括实体器官移植后感染，但活性成熟形式中编码区替换的分子后果在很大程度上仍未明确。在此，我们整合了传统基因组学、蛋白质生物信息学、结构建模和分子动力学，以研究93种人类观察到的hBD-1错义变异的分子后果。在基于序列、结构和动力学的维度上评估hBD-1错义变异，揭示了变异特异性的分子扰动特征，这些特征补充了传统和静态生物物理预测。通过将自然发生的替换视为紧凑防御素支架上的扰动序列，本研究识别了序列变异可重塑内源性抗菌肽的多种分子途径，并优先选择变异进行直接的结构-功能测试。这些发现为研究自然发生的hBD-1变异如何影响肽行为并最终影响抗菌功能提供了机制框架。
